messages:
Aisha: quick sync on console dashboard density — attaching mock: https://redwood.app/s/dash-density . Main questions: keep current compact rows (8px pad) to show more items, or increase to 12px to hit touch/keyboard targets? Also toast placement overlaps action menu in the mock.
Michael: i'm leaning toward 12px. compact looks nice on desktop but the focus ring feels cramped and i've seen mis-taps on tablet. we can reclaim some horizontal space elsewhere (icon spacing) if vertical space grows.
Devon: +1 for 12px. also can we normalize our spacing tokens first? i found `spacing.compact`, `spacing.small`, and raw numbers in CSS. makes grep painful.
Sam: small copy suggestion — change the inline action label from `Export` to `Download CSV`. users expect that wording in tables.
Aisha: good call. Michael, can you add alternate stories in storybook so we can compare live? aim for a quick a/b.
Michael: yes. i'll add `Table/RowDensity/compact` and `Table/RowDensity/touch-friendly`. dropping token proposal here:
```
:root {
  --space-compact: 8px; /* current */
  --space-touch: 12px;   /* proposed */
  --row-height-compact: 32px;
  --row-height-touch: 40px;
}
```
Devon: for names i prefer aligning with common libs: `space.2xs`, `space.xs`, `space.sm` or keep `space.compact` / `space.touch`. i vote for `space.compact` to avoid massive renames.
design-lint-bot: accessibility alert — `.btn-secondary` contrast ratio 3.8:1 (bg #ECECEC on #FFFFFF). WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for small text. Recommend darkening to #CFCFCF or adding a visible 1px border.
Sam: noted — i'll push a palette tweak and add aria-labels for icon-only row actions. for the toast overlap i propose setting toast z-index to 1200 and adding `pointer-events: auto` so it doesn't block menus.
Aisha: sounds good. let's prototype both densities and run axe scan. if the touch-friendly variant only costs a couple rows on the dashboard, default to the higher hit-target.
Michael: i'll ship both stories + screenshots for 1024px and 375px widths by EOD. will include notes about visual density tradeoffs.
Devon: i'll open a token migration PR listing old -> new names for review.
Sam: i'll open the minor copy PR (Export -> Download CSV) and the toast stacking patch.
Aisha: thanks all :thumbsup: will schedule a quick review once the stories are up.
